_note: See src/test/golden_vectors.rs's module doc comment for the schema. Each case lists every epoch's SignalSet fields needed to replay aggregate_from_ring exactly; expect.score/band/stale are read from RiskOracle::score() after posting every epoch in order (plus event_in_progress, applied after posting, for review decision D1's case).

cases.name: normal_band_healthy
cases.description: Every component at 0: no deviation, healthy liquidity, no redemption/issuer/supply activity, endpoint Up.

cases.name: watch_band_small_sustained_depeg
cases.description: A sustained (not single-epoch) depeg across the whole Depeg window, deep enough to raise P to ~70 (not 100, so the forced-Warning override does not apply), landing the weighted score in Watch's 25..=49 range.

cases.name: warning_band_raw_score_combination
cases.description: No single component saturates at 100 (so the forced-Warning override does not fire); P~60 from a sustained depeg, L=100 from liquidity below l_target, R~80 from sustained redemption pressure, I~80 from clawbacks, combine under the default weights to land in Warning's 50..=74 range on the raw weighted score alone.

cases.name: distress_band_depegged_and_down
cases.description: Severely depegged price, endpoint Down, heavy redemption and issuer activity: every component saturates, weighted score lands in Distress's 75..=100 range (also independently forced there by the E=100 override).

cases.name: forced_warning_p_saturates_at_100
cases.description: peg_ratio deviates by 50%, far past d_max (0.10), saturating component P at exactly 100. Every other component is 0, so the unforced weighted score (0.35 * 100 = 35) alone would only reach Watch; the Section 6.3 override is what forces this to Warning.

cases.name: forced_warning_e_saturates_at_100
cases.description: Only the latest final epoch's endpoint is Down (component E = 100); every other component is 0, so the unforced weighted score (0.20 * 100 = 20) alone would only reach Normal; the Section 6.3 override is what forces this to Warning.

cases.name: event_in_progress_forces_distress
cases.description: Healthy signals that would otherwise score Normal (0), but with review decision D1's event_in_progress flag set on the asset, read back as at least Distress. Applied at read time (score()), never persisted into the stored RiskScore.

cases.name: single_epoch_wick_does_not_move_the_band
cases.description: One epoch (150) spikes to 75% off peg; review item C3 computes component P from the 10th percentile of peg_ratio across the 72-epoch Depeg window, computed onchain, not a single epoch's value, so this single wick is excluded and the band stays Normal, matching percentile_p10_ignores_a_single_epoch_wick in test.rs.
